caption: The drawing depicts a metallic lock mechanism with a rectangular base that has an ornate plate on the right end featuring symmetrical points and circular holes for mounting. The main body of the lock is dark brown with rust-like textures and metallic shading, showing highlighted areas to suggest wear and dimensionality. A square metallic cover is attached to the lock's center with visible screws. Inside, mechanical elements are visible, including a curved lever and moving parts rendered in shades of black and gray. Extending from the left side of the lock are two rounded, yellowish-gold knobs or handles, shown overlapping and attached to a shaft. The background is a plain, light beige color. The artist's signature, "Sam W. Ford Del. 39091," is present in small, neat handwriting below and slightly to the right of the lock.
title: Lock
